# Plotbird

Plotbird is a Christchurch, New Zealand aerial mapping and property imagery business.

Website: https://plotbird.co.nz/
Email: plotbirdnz@gmail.com
Service area: Christchurch and Canterbury, New Zealand.

Core services:
- Drone mapping and orthomosaic imagery
- Property photogrammetry and 3D models
- Farm and rural aerial imagery
- Real estate aerial photography and video

Plotbird is not a licensed cadastral or engineering surveying practice. Where a job requires licensed survey work, Plotbird will say so.

Portfolio examples include farm, urban and shoreline mapping projects around Christchurch.
